description: This file contains unit tests for the WorkActivityStore component, specifically testing various job handling and tool management behaviors within the application.
external_methods: store.handleTool(sessionKey: String, phase: String, name: String, meta: Any?, args: [String: Any])

classes.name: WorkActivityStoreTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple test methods to verify the behavior of the WorkActivityStore.

methods.name: `main session job preempts other`
methods.description: Tests that a main session job preempts other session jobs and updates the icon state accordingly.

methods.name: `job stays working after tool result grace`
methods.description: Verifies that the job remains in a working state after a tool report, even after some delay, and concludes correctly when finished.

methods.name: `tool label extracts first line and shortens home`
methods.description: Checks that the tool label correctly extracts the first line of output and shortens the home directory path.

methods.name: `resolve icon state honors override selection`
methods.description: Ensures that the icon state can be overridden explicitly and that the override is respected.
